reset.title: Reset sign-in password
reset.permission: Only operators who can manage tenant accounts can reset sign-in passwords
reset.verifyDescription: Verify ownership of the tenant before resetting the password directly. When the customer can receive email, send a recovery email instead. The old password and existing sessions expire immediately after the reset.
reset.noteExample: For example, called the customer’s contact number on 11/20 and verified ownership

methods.phone: Call back the customer’s contact number
methods.transfer: Verify a corporate bank transfer receipt
methods.license: Verify the business licence and contact

reset.resultHint: The temporary password is shown once. Send it to the customer through the verified channel.
reset.copyFailed: Could not copy the password. Check your browser’s clipboard permissions.

recover.title: Send recovery email
recover.permission: Only operators who can manage tenant accounts can send account recovery emails
recover.verifyDescription: The recovery link goes to the email address below. After the customer sets a new password, they sign in with that address, and the old password and existing sessions expire. Make sure the address belongs to the tenant.
recover.sentDetail: Ask the customer to check their inbox and set a new password before the link expires. You can send it again if the link expires.
